## Change

Explain the problem, the resulting behavior and how it fits Vers's focus on fast,
practical play. Italian or English is welcome.

## Verification

List relevant tests and any manual checks. Mention migrations, environment
changes, compatibility constraints and any checks not performed.

- [ ] Examples, fixtures, logs and screenshots contain no credentials or real campaign/player data.
- [ ] I reviewed changes to permissions, dependencies and workflows where applicable.
- [ ] I updated setup/operations instructions if deployment behavior changed.
